en.headline: Domestic helper arrested after five-month-old baby found unconscious in Yuen Long
en.dek: Police detained a domestic helper on suspicion of child abuse after a five-month-old girl was found unconscious at a village house in Ha San Wai on Thursday evening.
body: Police arrested a domestic helper on Thursday evening on suspicion of child abuse after a five-month-old baby girl was found unconscious at a residence in Ha San Wai, Yuen Long.

The force received a report at about 7.20pm that an infant was unconscious at a village house along Castle Peak Road. Paramedics rushed the girl to Pok Oi Hospital in Yuen Long for emergency resuscitation before she was transferred to Tuen Mun Hospital.
A domestic helper was taken into custody for further investigation. Police are continuing their enquiries into the circumstances.
The case has been handed to the Yuen Long District Crime Squad.

zh.headline: 元朗五個月大女嬰昏迷送院 外傭涉虐兒被捕
zh.dek: 周四晚上元朗下新圍村一名五個月大女嬰被發現昏迷，警方以涉嫌虐兒拘捕一名外傭。
body: 警方周四晚上約7時20分接報，元朗青山公路下新圍村一村屋內有一名五個月大女嬰昏迷。
救護人員將女嬰送往元朗博愛醫院進行緊急搶救，其後轉送屯門醫院。
警方以涉嫌虐兒拘捕一名外傭，現正扣留調查。案件由元朗區重案組跟進。
警方呼籲市民如有相關資料可向警方提供。
